utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll check what we’ve got on hand and make a list of what’s still needed, with each item’s storage spot. Then I’ll pass it along so we can fill any gaps before the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll keep spreading the word and reminding folks about the plan for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great — I’m on it, and I’ll send the supply list over as soon as I’ve checked everything. That should help us see what’s still missing before the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — the repair drive is coming up soon. I’ll fill you in on everything, and Dane said he’ll lend a hand too; Faye just needs the details first so she can work around school pickup and drop-off.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it — I can wait for the full update, and it’s helpful that Faye just needs the details first. If there’s a list of anything still needed, I can keep an eye out too.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Nell — I’ll get you the full list. I’m pretty sure we still need a few basics, and I’ll pass the details along to Faye once I’ve got them sorted.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’ll bring a wrench for the repair drive. We’ve got those loose rails and the leaky faucet to sort out.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Good call. I’ll sort the donation list and check what tools we still need.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Nice — Hana can note your set, and Sam’s bringing the toolbox over too. Should be enough to tackle the rails and faucet.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can sort the donations or carry supplies when I get there. If Oren has those spare tools set out, that’d help a lot too.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds helpful, Sam. Send me the time and place, and I’ll wait for the clear plan before I commit.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure — I’ll send the time and place as soon as I have the clear plan.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, and the repair drive’s coming up—Gus is bringing a tape measure, drill, and a couple extension cords, and Jules is spreading the word and bringing tools.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks — I’m checking what needs fixing first. Do we still have the wrench covered, and is Uli available to help quietly?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m not sure about Uli, but I’ll check on the wrench and let you know if it’s covered.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, thanks—Mina, Jules, and Bo covering the tools will help a lot. I’m glad Opal plans to make it too.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I’ve got the tools covered. Want me to give Nell the rundown again before Sunday?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes, please—Nell would appreciate the rundown again before Sunday. Thanks for keeping the tools sorted.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good — I’ll swing by and lend a hand at the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, thanks, Dane — I’ll head to the tables when I get there and keep an eye on the setup.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Perfect — I’ll see you there and help wherever I’m needed.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ll bring my tape measure, drill, and a couple extension cords to the repair drive. And Tess can borrow my toolbox anytime.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Good, so you’ve got the tape measure, drill, and extension cords covered, right? And Tess can borrow the toolbox if she needs it?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yep, that’s covered — I’ve got the tape measure, drill, and extension cords. And Tess can borrow my toolbox whenever she needs it.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: It’s set up at the tables right now, so I’m pointing folks that way. I’m spreading the word to the neighbors and saving Opal a spot near the setup.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Nice, I’ll bring the tools and help pair people up when they arrive. If Ira mentions the repair drive, I’ll steer folks over that way too.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, Jules — that’ll help a lot. I’ll keep sending neighbors over to the tables and make sure Opal has a spot waiting.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’ll check the repair drive tools first and make a list of what still needs to be borrowed. Once Noah sends the details over, we can keep the list in order with the Wilsons and Maple corner house at the top.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect, I’ll swing by later and help wherever you need me. And I can use Gus’s toolbox if we end up short on anything.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That would be a big help, Tess — I’ll see what’s still missing first, and if we’re short I’ll let you know about Gus’s toolbox.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I brought the spare tools and sturdy boxes like I said I would. The sign-up sheet still needs a few more folks, so I’m checking what’s missing before we start.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Oren — I’ll keep the list tidy and make sure the Wilsons’ place and the corner house on Maple stay at the top. We’re still set for Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Good, Sunday at the community center works for me. I’ll keep looking over the sign-up sheet and see what else we still need.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Great, I can help with the repair drive. Pia’s handling the timing and supplies, right?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah, Pia’s handling the timing and supplies. I can help too, and I’ll keep my part quiet and low-key.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Uli — that works for me. Let’s keep it simple and clear with Pia’s timing.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Great, Rosa — thanks for keeping the list tidy. I’ll swing by later and help wherever needed at the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Tess — Sunday at the community center should work just fine. I’ll keep the Wilsons’ place and the corner house on Maple at the top of the list for you.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect — I’ll keep an eye out for the Wilsons’ place and the corner house on Maple when I stop by. See you Sunday at the community center!

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Quinn. I’ll wait for the time and place before I commit, and it’s good to know Rey and Dane may help.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: It’s at the tables right now, so that part’s set. I’ll keep spreading the word, and if you want in once the plan’s clear, I’ll point you straight there.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That works for me, Quinn. I’ll come by once I have the full plan.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Mina’s bringing the tools, and Mara and Cleo are checking what’s still needed and where it’s stored. Noah can use the list to see what we still need to borrow.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’ll swing by and lend a hand at the repair drive. Just let me know what’s still needed when the list’s ready.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Great, I’ll pass along the list as soon as Mara and Cleo finish it. Thanks for offering to help with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’ll keep mentioning the repair drive when it comes up.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Ira — we’ve already got a tape measure, a drill, a couple extension cords, and Sam’s toolbox items covered. Noah still wants a list of what else we need, so I’ll keep track.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll keep bringing it up while I’m out, and I’ll let folks know Noah still needs that list.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help, and I’ll keep it low-key and quiet. Oren can check the sign-up sheet, and Tess can pass along the rest quietly.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great, that works. I’ll bring tools and help match folks up for the repair drive so it stays smooth and quiet.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That sounds good, Jules. I appreciate you keeping it smooth and quiet.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: It’s Sunday at the community center, and I’ll bring my tools. I’ll also give Nell the rundown so everyone knows what to do.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That’s great, Mina. I can help by sorting donations or carrying supplies, whichever you need most.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Sam. Let’s start with sorting donations, then we can carry supplies if we need to.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, thanks — I’ve got the repair drive details and I’ll keep track of who’s bringing what. We’re set with Bo’s wrench and Jules’s tools, and I’m glad Opal can make it.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Nice, I’ll keep spreading the word and reminding folks about the plan. Sounds like we’re in good shape for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, thanks Vik — if you can keep folks in the loop, I’ll make sure we’re ready with the details Noah sends over.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Great, as long as I’ve got the timing and the full drop-off details, I can plan around it. I’m still sorting the remaining supplies, so I’d like to keep it organized.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’ve got it at the top right now. I’ll sort the donation list and check what tools are still needed.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Perfect, thanks — once you’ve got the donation list and the drop-off details, send them over and I’ll line up the timing on my end.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I may have missed the latest on the repair drive, but I’ll keep it low-key and send over the details as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So Leo’s sorting the donation list and checking what tools are still needed, right?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I think Cleo’s the one checking supplies, and Dane said he’d lend a hand. I may be a bit behind, but I’ll send the repair drive details as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: It’s at the tables right now. I’ll keep an eye on the location and head over there.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect — keep it at the top for now, and I’ll wait on Noah’s details.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it — the repair drive is still at the tables, and I’ll head there.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sounds good — I can help with the repair drive. Pia’s sorting out the timing and supplies, so I’ll keep an eye out for when we’re set.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great — I’ll bring the tape measure, drill, and a couple extension cords. Just let me know when Pia has the timing locked in.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Will do — I’ll wait on Pia’s timing and let you know as soon as it’s locked in.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hana’s checking what needs fixing first, and I think it’s the loose rails and the leaky faucet. Gus is grabbing tape and screws, and Hana’s meeting Mina too.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I brought some spare tools and a couple sturdy boxes for the repair drive. Let me check the sign-up sheet and see what we’re still missing.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Nice, that should help a lot. Let me know what’s still missing and I’ll keep it moving.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’ll check the repair drive tools first and make a list of what still needs to be borrowed. Then I can pass it along so we stay organized.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect—thanks, Mara. I’ll keep spreading the word and let folks know the repair drive is at the tables.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, thanks, Quinn. I’ll check the tools and send over the borrowing list as soon as I’ve got it.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’ll sort the donation list and check what tools we still need. We’re at the top of the repair drive now.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Leo — once you sort it, I’ll pass the updated supplies list along to Noah.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — I’ll send the updated list once I’ve sorted it.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with the repair drive. Just let me know the time and what supplies you need sorted out.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Rey — I’m still sorting the timing and the rest of the supplies. Once I have the full drop-off details, I’ll let you know what’s still missing.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sounds good — I’m around, so just send the time and I’ll help with whatever’s left.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I brought the spare tools and a few sturdy boxes for the repair drive. I checked the sign-up sheet too—looks like we still need a couple more hands and some extra tape.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That’s great—thanks for bringing those. I’ll keep mentioning the repair drive when I’m out, so hopefully we can round up a few more hands and some tape.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Ira. If you hear from Pia, could you ask her about timing and any supplies we’re missing?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Gus — I’ll swing by later and help wherever needed at the repair drive. And I’m glad you’re lending me your toolbox; that’ll come in handy.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: You bet — stop by whenever you can, and I’ll have the toolbox ready for you. I’m bringing a tape measure, drill, and a couple extension cords too.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’s perfect, Gus — sounds like you’ve got us well set up. I’ll see you later and put that toolbox to good use at the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I’ll bring my tools on Sunday at the community center. Do you need me to give Nell the rundown too?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Yeah, please confirm with Nell too. And just to be sure, Jules is still the one matching folks up, right?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yep, Jules is still matching folks up. I’ll give Nell the rundown too.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds fine — I’d like the details first so I can see the plan clearly. Once Noah sends them over, I can decide where I fit in.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m checking what needs fixing first and who’s bringing the tools. Gus has the tape and screws, and Uli can help quietly too.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good, that helps. Once Noah sends the details, I can look at the plan and see where I fit in.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: It’s set for Sunday at the community center, and I’m keeping the list tidy for Bo with the Wilsons’ place and the corner house on Maple right at the top. Mina’s ready with tools, and Tess will be there Sunday to help too.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help quietly and ask around discreetly. If anyone wants to lend a hand, I’ll send them your way.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’d be wonderful, Uli—please send anyone who’s willing my way, and I’ll keep the list organized.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sorry, I think I missed the latest on the repair drive. I’ve got the timing and drop-off details, and Jules can match folks up once I share them.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect—send me the timing and drop-off details, and I’ll spread the word and help match folks up. I’m also bringing a few tools along.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Great, thanks—Dane said he’ll lend a hand too, so I’ll send you the timing and drop-off details right now.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Mina’s bringing tools, and Mara’s already checking what’s still needed. I’d keep an eye on the list so we know what else to borrow.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’ll check the toolbox and bring whatever useful items I can find.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’d be great, Sam. If you spot anything missing, just add it to the list so we can borrow the rest.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’ll bring a wrench for the repair drive. Rosa’s keeping the list tidy, right?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes — Rosa’s keeping the list tidy, and the repair drive is at the tables right now. I’ll head there and keep track of it.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, I’ll swing by the tables soon with the wrench. Glad Rosa’s got the list tidy.
